name: Ezer (an Ephraimite)
title: An Ephraimite killed by the men of Gath
summary: Ezer was one of Ephraim's descendants who were killed by the people of Gath when they tried to take their livestock. Their father Ephraim mourned them for a long time.

keyEvents.title: Killed by the men of Gath
keyEvents.description: Ezer and Elead were killed by the people of Gath, and their father Ephraim mourned them for a long time.
